## Problem Statement
**What problem does this feature solve?**
A clear description of the issue — e.g., "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution
**What would you like to happen?**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered
**What alternatives have you considered?**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Example
**How would this feature look/work?**
Provide mockups, wireframes, or examples from other apps.

## Impact
- **Users affected**: All users / Specific cities / Mobile / Desktop
- **Priority**: Low / Medium / High / Critical
- **Effort estimate**: Small (hours) / Medium (days) / Large (weeks)

## Additional Context
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
